verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at docs.mangopay.com/_mcp/server, so an agent can connect to a first-party MCP endpoint. Its location on the docs domain suggests it may serve documentation rather than payment API operations, and the pack gives no detail on tools, auth or setup. Supporting AI-readiness signals include llms.txt agent instructions, Markdown page versions and an OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool list or scope (docs vs. API actions), setup and auth instructions for agent clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
